routeHint: Sidebar -> Analytics, then the Communication tab. The tab key is 'communication' (client/src/views/App/Stats/Stats.vue:236) and it is gated by showCommunicationTab, so sign in as a tenant admin. The page needs the period selector and the three summary cards rendered before capture. The period buttons are 7 days / 30 days / 90 days / 12 months and the tab opens on 30 days. The demo organisation's newest discussion post is dated 2026-02-11, so at 30 days every figure on this tab reads 0; capture at 12 months. Checked 2026-11-11: discussion.main_post_created_at was NULL on all 97 demo discussions, which zeroes 'posts published' at any period, and was backfilled from the main post's date_created.
alt: Communication tab of Analytics with the period selector, the audience, posts and newsletter summary cards, and the best time to post chart
